notes: TypeSafe official price for Jev, from docs.typesafe.ai/models (typesafe.ai/pricing returned 404; there is no separate marketing price page). Raw unit as published: $42 per Btok, i.e. $0.042 per Mtok ("Price (per Btok / per Mtok) | $42 / $0.042"), charged per input token; output tokens are free; no per-request fee or free tier is listed. Rate limits on the docs page 2026-10-07: "100K tokens per second / 80 requests per second" ("adjusting dynamically"; higher limits on custom/enterprise plans). THIRD-PARTY RESELLER/AGGREGATOR NOT USED AS A PRICE SOURCE: jevaihub.com/pricing is an independent site ("not affiliated with or endorsed by TypeSafe"); its price matches ($0.042) but its snapshot of 2026-09-30 recorded 40 requests per second, a conflict with the official 80 (limits changed). A Vercel AI Gateway price for Jev ($0.042 under typesafe-ai/jev) is reported only by that third-party site and was not verified (Vercel page 404). Context: docs say 64k tokens per request and 32k for state plus the longest question; OpenRouter lists 32,000. Jev price per decision depends on state size, questions and fan-out; this table is the raw rate only. Cache fields: cache_read_per_m and cache_write_per_m are set EQUAL to fresh_input_per_m because the vendor documents no caching discount or surcharge; they are not published rates.
